definition: The square root of the mean of ln(high / close) ln(high / open) plus ln(low / close) ln(low / open), over the last window bars, per bar and not annualised.
boundaries: Stays unbiased when the price drifts, unlike Parkinson's and Garman-Klass's; it still ignores the gap from the last close to the open.
recognition: Higher means bigger moves inside the bars.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
